sloka: छायावैगुण्यमात्रं तु शङ्केः दुःखमुपस्थितम् ।अदुःखार्हामिमां देवीं वैहायसमुपस्थिताम् ।। ५.२७.४६।।।।
transliteration: chāyāvaiguṇyamātraṁ tu śaṅkeḥ duḥkhamupasthitam ।aduḥkhārhāmimāṁ devīṁ vaihāyasamupasthitām ।। 5.27.46।।।।

translations.english: A great suffering has befallen a lady who does not deserve to suffer. Therefore, a change in her complexion has occured.
